hypergraph.vertex: one of the six variables of R
hypergraph.edge: S -> i for every single-flip row witness D_i=(-l_i OR S), where every literal of S has the same polarity as R
hypergraph.closure: starting with the variables of S, repeatedly add head i whenever some witness support for i is contained in the current set

dichotomy: FULL_CLOSURE: if some witness seed closes to all six variables, assumptions negating its support force every literal of R false and certify RUP deletion of the opposite head literal from that witness

PROPER_CLOSED_CORE: if no witness seed has full closure, the closure of every seed is a nonempty proper support-closed subset; emit the lexicographically minimal one as an exact obstruction certificate
